item.title: Future-ready safety: Powering nearshore FLNG installations – Part one
item.description: A safety report by ABS explores design considerations for innovative floating LNG power solutions to support the energy transition industry.

item.title: Wood secures contract extension with Woodside
item.description: Wood has secured a two-year contract extension worth up to US$65 million with Woodside to continue delivering brownfield EPCM services across offshore as-sets at the North West Shelf project in Western Australia.

item.title: Future-ready safety: Powering nearshore FLNG installations – Part two
item.description: A safety report by ABS explores design considerations for innovative floating LNG power solutions to support the energy transition industry.

item.title: Argent LNG and Tecnimont sign strategic term sheet
item.description: Argent LNG, LLC and Tecnimont S.p.A. have signed a term sheet establishing a strategic framework for Tecnimont’s participation and long-term execution alignment in the Argent LNG export project.

item.title: Wood Mackenzie: Five global gas and LNG themes to look out for in 2026
item.description: Global gas and LNG markets stand at an inflection point as record supply growth meets uncertain demand recovery and mounting regulatory pressures, according to Wood Mackenzie.

item.title: BC Hydro signs MoU with Ksi Lisims LNG for North Coast Transmission Line
item.description: BC Hydro has signed a memorandum of understanding with Ksi Lisims LNG for how and when BC Hydro will deliver clean electricity to the proposed floating LNG facility.

item.title: SEA-LNG: Shipping’s methane decarbonisation pathway becomes a clear runway for the future
item.description: SEA-LNG has published its annual ‘View from the Bridge’ report, highlighting 2025 as a year of strong growth in LNG, bio-LNG, and e-methane emissions reductions, costs and availability.

item.title: LNGCON provides safe drinking water in Uganda
item.description: With the support of its delegates, LNGCON has installed a water supply station in Uganda, followed by comprehensive monitoring and quality checks.

item.title: Glenfarne announces strategic partnership with Danaos
item.description: Danaos Corp. has signed a strategic partnership with Glenfarne Alaska LNG, LLC for the construction and operation of at least six LNG carriers to deliver LNG to global customers from the Alaska LNG project.

item.title: Chiyoda awarded FEED contract by QatarEnergy
item.description: Chiyoda Corp., has been awarded a FEED contract by QatarEnergy LNG for the North Field West LNG onshore facilities in Qatar.
